name: VoxelSDF Decoder (Grid Latent Sampling + MLP)
definition: Predicts Signed Distance Function (SDF) values at 3D query points by interpolating a gridded latent code and passing it through an MLP.
summary: The VoxelSDF Decoder predicts SDF values by interpolating a spatially varying latent grid and processing it through an MLP, enabling complex, non-rigid geometries unlike single-vector methods.
